caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 108 of 1996.
lawyer:
Md. Ozair Farooq, Advocate-on-Record — For the Petitioners. 
Sharifuddin Chaklader, Advocate-on-Record — For the Respondent No.1. Not represented — Respondent No. 2.
parties:
Moinuddin Ahmed and another ----- Defendant-Petitioners
Vs
Government of Bangladesh, represented by the Secretary, Ministry of Public Works and Urban Development and another  ----- Plaintiff-Respondents.
full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Ozair Farooq, learned Advocate, appearing for the defendant-petitioners submits, first, that the petitioners being bonafide purchasers of the suit property in auction sale from court by virtue of Execution Case No. 7 of 1972 arising out of Money Suit No. 25 of 1969, the plaintiff cannot get a declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit property without setting aside the decree passed in Money Suit No. 25 of 1969 and further the proceeding in Money Execution Case No. 7 of 1972 cannot be declared as void.
